theme.description: Editorial Indonesian Fashion Haute-Minimalism with warm parchment canvas, charcoal couture typography, deep terracota/bordeaux accents, crisp monochrome data hierarchy for multi-marketplace seller studio, and mobile-first responsive touchpoints.

rules.caption: font-sans font-medium text-xs tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground

entry_surfaces./: editorial split hero with oversized couture typography and dual ID/EN quick switch, curated looks rail right, followed by multi-marketplace sync highlight and conversational AI stylist widget
entry_surfaces./login: luxury minimal auth split — left high-fashion lookbook portrait with brand manifesto, right clean credential panel with quick customer vs seller preset switcher
entry_surfaces./register: luxury minimal auth split — left high-fashion lookbook portrait with brand manifesto, right registration form with role selector customer/admin seller
entry_surfaces./stylist: immersive editorial AI atelier — left interactive prompt and style drawer, right dynamic look canvas with live store inventory pairing cards
entry_surfaces./seller: precision seller studio with marketplace tabs (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada), AI listing copy generator with single-click clipboard sync, and product inventory table
entry_surfaces./checkout: refined order summary with Indonesian Rupiah formatting (Rp), shipping courier select, and Midtrans Snap payment gateway modal simulation/real flow

layout_and_grids.structure: Mobile-first editorial layout with generous vertical rhythm (py-16 md:py-24), asymmetric bento highlights, and sticky glass navigation bar with blur and subtle border.
layout_and_grids.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8
layout_and_grids.mobile_rules: Bottom navigation floating pill for mobile shoppers with quick access to Catalog, AI Stylist, Cart sheet with counter badge, and Seller Switcher.

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out

presets.fade_in: { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 12 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.35 } }

accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast against respective surfaces. Dark text #141413 on #FAF8F5 offers 17.5:1 ratio; accent #9F2B2B text on white offers 6.8:1 ratio.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (cart drawer trigger, language switch, search, favorite, copy button) must have descriptive aria-label and data-testid

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive control and key data display must include data-testid with kebab-case descriptor

key_components: frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx (Bilingual switcher ID/EN, Role switch, Cart Sheet trigger, Stylist link)
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx (Editorial footer with newsletter, fashion house manifesto, marketplace badges)
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx (Editorial ratio 3:4 product card with quick add and hover preview)
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx (Slide-over sheet with item quantity controls, subtotal in IDR, and Midtrans checkout button)
frontend/src/components/MidtransModal.tsx (Midtrans Snap payment simulation with QRIS, Virtual Account BCA/Mandiri/BRI, GoPay, and Card options)
frontend/src/components/AiStylistChat.tsx (Streaming Gemini chat with occasion badges, moodboard generation, and direct product recommendation links)
frontend/src/components/AiListingGenerator.tsx (Multi-channel title/description/tags optimizer for Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada with instant copy button and CSV export)
frontend/src/components/SellerProductTable.tsx (Central catalog manager with modal CRUD, inventory count, and sync status)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. EDITORIAL LOOK & FEEL: Treat FASHION_MART as a high-end fashion tech platform combining Vogue-like editorial restraint with sharp e-commerce utility.
2. BILINGUAL SUPPORT: Provide a lightweight translation helper/store supporting Indonesian (default) and English across all nav links, button texts, stylist prompt suggestions, and seller tools.

3. MIDTRANS PAYMENT GATEWAY: Implement a realistic Midtrans Snap interactive modal that triggers on checkout, displays simulated QRIS, BCA/Mandiri/BRI Virtual Account, and GoPay payment methods with instant status update to 'Settlement / Paid' upon confirmation.

4. AI FASHION STYLIST: Provide a rich AI conversational stylist using Gemini (via Emergent LLM integration or backend endpoint) that understands Indonesian/English style requests (e.g., 'OOTD Kondangan Modern Minimalis budget under Rp 1.500.000', 'Smart Casual interview kantor SCBD') and pairs actual store products into matching sets.

5. SELLER STUDIO & AI LISTING GENERATOR: Allow sellers to input brief product notes and generate customized marketplace copy for Shopee (high search volume tags, SEO title format), Tokopedia (official store style specifications), TikTok Shop (hook + trending hashtags), and Lazada with one-click copy and CSV export.

6. SEED DATA & MOCK RESILIENCE: Seed at least 8-12 realistic Indonesian fashion items (Batik Kontemporer, Linen Oversized Blazer, Silk Scarf, Culotte Trousers, Vegan Leather Tote, etc.) in IDR currency (e.g., Rp 249.000 - Rp 1.890.000) with working cart persistence in localStorage/state.

7. MOBILE EXCELLENCE: Ensure touch targets are at least 44px, drawer animations are smooth, and the mobile bottom navigation or floating quick action gives frictionless access to the AI Stylist and Cart.
